product.industry: Numbered collectible furniture and small-run spatial objects sold directly by an independent design bureau
product.audience: A design-literate collector or residential specifier checking whether a limited object fits a real room before placing a reservation
product.decision: Select a span and finish, verify wall clearance and material character, then decide whether the resulting edition, lead time, price, and deposit suit the room
product.conversion: Reserve one configured edition with a named placement code and receive an immediate on-page reservation record

signature.moment: A live WebGL room widens to the supplied wall dimension while Ledge 02 changes span and material, shifts between elevation, corner and plan viewpoints, and resolves the remaining clearance into a reservable placement code

systems.hero: A product docket introduces the physical object photographically; the immediately following composer is the signature full-width spatial instrument, preventing the 3D room from becoming decorative hero spectacle
systems.navigation: A narrow horizontal catalogue header exposes Objects, Place, Materials, and Making; Index opens a centered full-screen folio rather than a side drawer, while mobile reduces the header to wordmark, current edition, and one Index control
systems.contentDensity: Precise object data and dimensions cluster around product decisions; full-bleed installation and material studies create quieter intervals without empty cinematic scroll tracks
systems.geometry: A twelve-column drafting sheet with registration crosses, dimension brackets, offset rules, rectangular swatches, and plan-view silhouettes; cards, portal crops, pills, circles, and repeated equal modules are excluded
systems.motion: Three.js interpolates wall width, object span, camera viewpoint and placement position only after visitor input; Framer Motion registers updated readouts, with no auto-rotation or decorative loop and a static reduced-motion pose
systems.coreInteraction: A spatial room composer combines Ledge 02 span, material, wall width, object position and camera viewpoint; it renders the result in 3D while calculating side clearance, fit guidance, edition availability, lead time, price, deposit and placement code

mobile.archetype: Swatch wallet and one-hand placement sheet
structuralDifferences: The mobile first fold is a pocket-sized swatch wallet with current finish, edition count, and Place in your room action; the desktop's full installation stage and marginal product dossier are removed from the first screen
Desktop keeps finish, span, wall width, plan, and output visible at once; mobile turns the same state into an explicit three-step sequence—Swatch, Span, Place—with visible next and back controls
The desktop plan is a landscape room diagram with side clearances; mobile rotates the grammar into a vertical wall strip and measured object block sized for thumb-led comparison
Reservation is a right-hand column inside the desktop placement sheet but becomes a full-width continuation below the mobile plan, never a drawer or bottom sheet

artDirection.typography: Use a compact neo-grotesk system stack for object names and a monospace system stack for edition data, measurements, and registry codes; hierarchy comes from alignment, indents, and numeric rhythm rather than giant uppercase type or a decorative italic-serif pairing
artDirection.material: Warm vellum, carbon ink, oxidised clay, charred ash, and cool brushed aluminium; surfaces look handled and architectural, with thin registration rules and no glossy luxury gradients
artDirection.imageLogic: Three local WebP photographs carry physical evidence while the configurable room, console, measurement grid and camera views are code-native WebGL; semantic HTML retains every numerical result
artDirection.microcopy: Use object-led vocabulary such as span, return, side clearance, finish batch, edition, maker mark, lead window, placement code, and reservation deposit; avoid generic shop, discover, elevate, timeless, and curated copy
artDirection.dataHonesty: All products, prices, edition numbers, dimensions, lead windows, and reservation codes are clearly fictional demonstration inventory; room-fit guidance is a simple geometric check, not installation or safety advice

interactions.name: Room and material composer
interactions.input: Collector chooses Charred ash, Clay lacquer, or Brushed aluminium; selects 160, 200, or 240 centimetre span; and supplies a 260, 320, or 380 centimetre wall width
interactions.stateChange: The scaled plan, object finish, clearance rules, fit status, lead window, price, deposit, edition number, and placement code recompute from local deterministic data
interactions.visibleResult: A live placement output states exact side clearance, whether the recommended 30 centimetre margin is met, configured dimensions, finish batch, edition availability, lead window, total, deposit, and plan code

interactions.name: Edition reservation
interactions.input: Collector accepts a valid placement, opens the inline record, submits name, email, project location, and reservation acknowledgement
interactions.stateChange: Invalid fields produce an announced error summary; valid local submission marks the configured edition as reservation recorded without any external request
interactions.visibleResult: The form is replaced by a reservation record containing the exact placement code, object, finish, dimensions, deposit, lead window, and a Return to plan action

interactions.name: Object ledger dossier
interactions.input: Visitor chooses one of four numbered object rows
interactions.stateChange: The adjacent dossier updates function, dimensions, edition size, material note, price, and silhouette without navigating to a generic product card page
interactions.visibleResult: A live dossier names the chosen object and exposes its authentic object data in the same registry grammar

assetStrategy: A coordinated three-frame local WebP storyboard establishes object silhouette, domestic scale, and material construction; each frame has one non-interchangeable evidence role, while all configurable state is rendered code-native so palette and dimensions remain honest

assets.role: Hero evidence for the Ledge 02 console's low monolithic span, asymmetric return, and collectible-object silhouette on a sparse studio stage
assets.focalCrop: Landscape 3:2 frame with the complete console occupying the central-right 62 percent and open plaster floor around all feet for measurement overlays
assets.mobileSafeArea: Square center crop preserves the complete console and contact shadow; no essential object edge or join sits in the outer 12 percent

assets.role: Domestic scale proof showing one Sill 01 lounge chair in a lived-in collector room, used only in the object ledger dossier
assets.focalCrop: Wide room view with the chair low-left, clear walking space, a restrained side table, and human-scale architecture without people
assets.mobileSafeArea: Portrait crop retains the entire chair, floor contact, and one adjacent architectural edge in the central 70 percent

assets.role: Construction proof for the material section: a macro junction between charred ash, brushed aluminium, and a clay lacquer edge
assets.focalCrop: Tight diagonal macro with all three materials meeting near the lower-right third and tactile grain visible across the frame
assets.mobileSafeArea: Tall crop preserves the three-way seam in the central 55 percent with texture extending safely above and below

libraryScan.latestResolution: Directory modification time fallback, used because the task prohibits Git work and no explicit creation metadata was found in the sampled template documents
libraryScan.repeatedPatternsExcluded: Pinned expanding-image heroes, oversized uppercase display, filter grids, persistent floating players, right-hand commerce drawers, and full-screen finale slogans

adjacentTemplates.why: MORA uses a three-scene pinned room story, project selector, fact grid, giant finale, and consultation drawer; Vellum is a non-scrolling product docket and measured commerce system whose primary state is a dimensioned room fit and inline reservation

Loom+Co uses a familiar image-and-copy hero, eight-product card grid, principles, testimonial, and newsletter; this template uses registry rows, one architectural placement system, edition provenance, and a configured deposit outcome instead of quick-add cards

SEREIN relies on a pinned expanding image, oversized display typography, collection grid, product configurator, bag drawer, and appointment drawer; Vellum avoids hero choreography and drawers while relating material and dimensions to a real room plan and numbered furniture edition

VANTA is a four-scene scroll film with orbital product art, edition cards, giant image finale, and allocation drawer; Vellum uses an immediately available drafting sheet, measured clearance logic, ledger-driven dossiers, and an inline reservation record

avoid: Sticky or scroll-pinned campaign sequence, expanding portal image, parallax object, orbit loop, or progress theatre
Generic product-card grid, quick-add affordance, cart drawer, floating bag, wishlist, or checkout imitation
Giant all-caps slogan, italic-serif counterpoint, circular call to action, pill cloud, or image finale that repeats the hero
Room visualizer claims, photorealistic AR language, structural safety claims, or inventory signals not supported by the local deterministic model
Mobile as a compressed desktop plan, swipe-only swatches, fixed controls that obscure content, or a bottom-sheet reservation
Interchangeable lifestyle assets reused across hero, ledger, materials, and footer
